# routeros_routing_isis_interface_template (Resource)




<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `instance` (String) Name of the IS-IS instance the matching interfaces are attached to.

### Optional

- `___id___` (Number) <em>Resource ID type (.id / name). This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `___path___` (String) <em>Resource path for CRUD operations. This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `___skip___` (String) <em>A set of transformations for field names. This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `___ts___` (String) <em>A set of transformations for field names. This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `___unset___` (String) <em>A set of fields that require setting/unsetting. This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `bcast_l1_csnp_interval` (String) The interval between the complete sequence number PDUs sent by the designated intermediate system on a level 1 broadcast circuit.
- `bcast_l1_hello_interval` (String) The interval between the IIH PDUs sent on a level 1 broadcast circuit.
- `bcast_l1_hello_interval_dr` (String) The interval between the IIH PDUs sent on a level 1 broadcast circuit while this router is the designated intermediate system. It is normally a third of `bcast_l1_hello_interval`.
- `bcast_l1_hello_multiplier` (Number) The number of missed hellos after which a level 1 broadcast adjacency is declared down. The advertised holding time is the hello interval multiplied by this value.
- `bcast_l1_metric` (Number) The level 1 metric of a broadcast circuit.
- `bcast_l1_priority` (Number) The priority used in the election of the level 1 designated intermediate system on a broadcast circuit. The highest priority wins.
- `bcast_l1_psnp_interval` (String) The minimum interval between the partial sequence number PDUs sent on a level 1 broadcast circuit.
- `bcast_l2_csnp_interval` (String) The interval between the complete sequence number PDUs sent by the designated intermediate system on a level 2 broadcast circuit.
- `bcast_l2_hello_interval` (String) The interval between the IIH PDUs sent on a level 2 broadcast circuit.
- `bcast_l2_hello_interval_dr` (String) The interval between the IIH PDUs sent on a level 2 broadcast circuit while this router is the designated intermediate system. It is normally a third of `bcast_l2_hello_interval`.
- `bcast_l2_hello_multiplier` (Number) The number of missed hellos after which a level 2 broadcast adjacency is declared down. The advertised holding time is the hello interval multiplied by this value.
- `bcast_l2_metric` (Number) The level 2 metric of a broadcast circuit.
- `bcast_l2_priority` (Number) The priority used in the election of the level 2 designated intermediate system on a broadcast circuit. The highest priority wins.
- `bcast_l2_psnp_interval` (String) The minimum interval between the partial sequence number PDUs sent on a level 2 broadcast circuit.
- `comment` (String)
- `disabled` (Boolean)
- `interfaces` (Set of String) Interfaces to match. Both interface names and interface list names are accepted.
- `levels` (Set of String) The IS-IS levels the matching interfaces form adjacencies on.
- `passive` (Boolean) If enabled, then do not send or receive IS-IS traffic on the matching interfaces, but still advertise the attached networks.
<em>This property is a flag: the correct value may not be displayed in Winbox, check it in the console.</em>
- `place_before` (String) Before which position the rule will be inserted.  
	> Please check the effect of this option, as it does not work as you think!  
	> Best way to use in conjunction with a data source. See [example](../data-sources/ip_firewall.md#example-usage).
- `ptp` (Boolean) Treat the matching interfaces as point to point circuits instead of broadcast circuits. The `ptp_*` properties are the ones that apply then.
<em>This property is a flag: the correct value may not be displayed in Winbox, check it in the console.</em>
- `ptp_hello_3way` (Boolean) Use the three way handshake of RFC 5303 when bringing up a point to point adjacency.
<em>This property is a flag: the correct value may not be displayed in Winbox, check it in the console.</em>
- `ptp_hello_interval` (String) The interval between the IIH PDUs sent on a point to point circuit.
- `ptp_hello_multiplier` (Number) The number of missed hellos after which a point to point adjacency is declared down. The advertised holding time is the hello interval multiplied by this value.
- `ptp_l1_csnp_interval` (String) The interval between the complete sequence number PDUs sent on a level 1 point to point circuit.
- `ptp_l1_metric` (Number) The level 1 metric of a point to point circuit.
- `ptp_l1_psnp_interval` (String) The minimum interval between the partial sequence number PDUs sent on a level 1 point to point circuit.
- `ptp_l2_csnp_interval` (String) The interval between the complete sequence number PDUs sent on a level 2 point to point circuit.
- `ptp_l2_metric` (Number) The level 2 metric of a point to point circuit.
- `ptp_l2_psnp_interval` (String) The minimum interval between the partial sequence number PDUs sent on a level 2 point to point circuit.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `inactive` (Boolean)
